_doc: Case definitions for evals/harness/eval.py. Prompts and checks mirror evals/test_matrix.md. auto checks are case-insensitive regexes run against the agent's text in the transcript; 'absent' checks must NOT match. manual checks are graded by a person in grading.md. 'no_failed_queries': true adds an auto check that the skill itself ran no failing SQL (Cortex Code's own CORTEX_CODE lookups don't count). Automation (`eval.py run`): 'suites' are named selections ({case: repeats}); 'block' orders a batch (A before B ... so runs that add dbt builds go last); 'setup.once' runs before a case's first run in a batch and 'setup.each' before every run (commands must be idempotent); 'answers' maps a regex on a Cortex picker question to the reply (default: the next prompt); 'turn_timeout_minutes' caps one agent turn.
